text:
Ava: quick heads up — starting a canary for graceful degradation logic for private control-plane tenants with egress locked down. want to align on policy order and console surface before rollout.
Ravi: do we have a clear eval order? e.g., 1) allowed-region check, 2) egress-allowlist, 3) tier routing, 4) model-variant fallback?
Jasper: +1 for explicit ordering. also need telemetry hooks to measure 'failed-to-fallback' vs 'fallback-success' rates. otherwise we'll miss silent failures.
Maya: proposal: introduce `grace_period_seconds` per-tenant + `fallback_targets` list. example config:```json
{
  "tenant_id": "acme-corp",
  "grace_period_seconds": 60,
  "fallback_targets": ["local-quantized-v2","local-onnx-lite"]
}
```
Maya: important: fallback_targets must be validated against onprem model catalog (control plane only), not fallback to hosted endpoints for private tenants.
Lara: console UX: show a per-request indicator when egress blocks an external fallback and instead a local variant is used. add a small banner in tenant settings: "This tenant has restricted egress; external fallbacks disabled."
Ravi: what about region constraints? some customers pin allowed regions — if fallback target exists only in another region we should not route there. need a `region_compatibility` check.
Jasper: telemetry detail: emit a structured event `policy_evaluation` with fields `step`, `result`, `chosen_target` — will let us build dashboards for false positives.
ops-bot: [automated check] found 1 tenant in canary set with missing `fallback_targets` -> tenant: acme-corp-testing. See /ops/tenants/171234 for details.
Ava: ok action items so far: 1) Maya to add `grace_period_seconds` + validation in control plane API (PR), 2) Ravi to add region_compatibility check, 3) Jasper to outline telemetry schema, 4) Lara to mock console banner + request indicator.
Maya: small edge-case: if `grace_period_seconds` expires and no local fallback available, we should surface a clear 503 with code `NO_LOCAL_FALLBACK` and an audit log entry that includes the evaluated policy chain.
Ravi: agree. also add a per-tenant soft-quota bump toggle for canary so we don't hit token quotas while testing.
Lara: UX note: in rollout we should show a timeline + sample requests affected, and a one-click rollback to disable graceful-degrade per-tenant.
Jasper: one more: make sure `KMS` operations for model keys aren't delayed during fallback path — check lock contention on onprem HSM calls. I've seen timeouts there cause cascading failures.
Maya: adding a short-circuit: if HSM latency > 500ms, skip encrypted model load and return `NO_LOCAL_FALLBACK` (fail-fast) so clients don't sit waiting.
Ava: timeline: implement API + validation this sprint, telemetry + dashboards next sprint, console UX in parallel. onboarding doc for support + SRE.
Ravi: canary target: 5 tenants in eu-west + 3 in us-west with strict egress. enable for them tomorrow 10:00 PDT.
Jasper: I'll create the dashboard: `private-routing/fallback-vs-failed` and add alerts when failure rate > 3% over 5m.
ops-bot: [deploy-bot] canary job scheduled for 2024-03-20T17:00Z by @Ava.
Lara: thanks — I'll draft the banner copy: "Traffic may be served by a local model variant due to egress restrictions. See audit logs for details."
Ava: perfect. if anyone sees missing telemetry in the canary immediately ping #eng-oncall. :thumbsup:
